entities.summary: Oliver Blackburn Shallenberger was an American electrical engineer and inventor. He is associated with electrical inventions related to alternating current. He is most noted for inventing the first successful alternating current (AC) electrical meter, the forerunner of the modern electric meter. This was critical to general acceptance of AC power. Oliver B. Shallenberger was a scientists & inventors from Rochester (1860-05-07, Rochester–1898-01-23). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
